topic: The bright side of the 2027 Fire Sheep: the eighth sign, the number of prosperity, and the strongest Yin sign, rewarding patience, beauty, romance and peace.
phrases: The number of prosperity arrives in February.
The quiet person in the room is about to have a very good year.
Lose and lose and lose, and all of a sudden the Sheep wins.

images.concept: Eight small lights in a gentle arc: the number of prosperity, held quietly.
images.prompt: A warm cinematic still life at dusk. Eight small hammered brass bowls arranged in a gentle arc on a dark weathered wooden table, each holding one small floating candle. Antique gold light pools on the wood; the background falls into midnight jade shadow with a soft blur of dusty rose silk. Calm, generous, unhurried. No people. No words, letters or numerals. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman at work on something beautiful, unhurried, seen from behind.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a woman seen from behind at a wooden studio table by a tall window, painting slowly on a small canvas. Soft late afternoon light, dusty rose and sage tones, antique gold on the brushes in a brass cup. Her face is not visible. The feeling is patient, absorbed, quietly prosperous. No words or lettering. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Card-style text image of the week's core line.
images.text: The quiet one is about to have a very good year.
images.prompt: An elegant typographic image on a warm ivory background with a faint parchment texture and thin antique gold filigree at the corners. Centered text in refined serif lettering, deep plum ink: "The quiet one is about to have a very good year." Spell every word perfectly. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Earth and fire making metal: a single gold ring resting on warm soil beside a small flame.
images.prompt: A cinematic object still life: a plain antique gold ring resting on a small mound of dark rich earth, a single candle burning low beside it on an old wooden surface. Warm brass light, deep shadow, shallow depth of field. Elemental and quiet. No people. No words or lettering. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Overhead flat lay of a beauty ritual: the Sheep's home ground.
images.prompt: An overhead flat lay photograph on warm ivory linen: a small brass compact, a sprig of dried peony, a glass bottle of rose oil, morning light. Antique gold and dusty rose tones. A woman's hand enters the frame from one side, reaching for the bottle; no face visible. No words or lettering. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
